headline: "Just One Day After Pickup, a 10,000 Yuan Price Cut?" Tesla's Limited-Time Price Cut Angers New Car Owners: Collective Demand for "Refund of the Price Difference," Sales Staff Cry Foul and Face Doubt
summary: Tesla's limited-time price cut in China prompted new car owners to demand refunds of the price difference, while sales staff faced doubts over the move. The reports come from Chinese media.
why: Tesla is the largest pure electric vehicle maker, and China is one of its biggest markets, so pricing changes there affect sales and margins.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: A short-term price cut in China affects Tesla's pricing, customer relations and margins in its China market.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
